settings.privacy_body_1: API ozhibii'igewinan biindaakojigemagad gidoojibii'igewin (localStorage) mii dash endazhi-izhiwebizid AI {provider} API — gaawiin wiikaa odaapinaasii mashkimod-azhegiiwesiing. Gagaanoozhim wiikaa wanichigan: giizhi-maajii'an ozhibii'igewin mii dash giizhibaa-biminizha'an, gemaa aabajitoon gidoojibii'igewin waasamoo-aabajichigan wanichigan.
settings.privacy_body_2: Oo-mazina'igan biindaakojigemagad gidoojibii'igewin localStorage: gimiiwendi-aabajichigan, gidobii'igewin, gimiikanabiitoon (Web/Native), gimiikana-bagidinigaade, giin aabitawijigewin, giin AI {provider} gaa-nandomad, bezhi API ozhibii'igewin apane gaa-biindaakojigeyan, mii dash gidozhibii'igewin aadizookaanansan (mazinaakizigan, anang-dakoziwin, mii dash gaa-apinenimigaazojig). Gaawiin aanind mazina'igan biindaakojigesii gemaa izhiwebizisii.

about.what_body: Mii o'ow gaa-pi-izhi-wiindamoonaan ji-wiidookawizoyaan accessibility audit gaa-ozhibii'igeyan. Gaawiin gichi-animizi — mii eta go bezhig gaa-izhichigeyan, mii dash waa-izhichigeyan miinawaa. Waabishkizi sa go. Gaa-pi-maajii'igeyan azhigwa, giga-gikendaan aaniin e-izhi-naabishkaadamaang wiin-wiinawaa accessibility dibaajimowin. Niwii-ganawenimaa niibi-naan-gichi-bimaadiziwin ji-maajiishkaayang gaa-tazhiigeyaang chi-mashkimoding gaa-ozhibii'igaadegin gaa-pi-maajii'igaadegin accessibility audits gaa-tebibiinaagozijig.
about.what_wcag: O'ow odapinamaagewin omaajiitaan {wcag} (Level A miinawaa AA).
about.step_1_body: Ozhibii'an gaa-waabandaman — component, elemento, aaniin ezhi-ikidoying.
about.step_2_body: Aabaji'an Priority Up/Priority Down mitigomizii-ishkwaandem mii dash waaboozid. Anangoons maajii-naagwad. Wiindamaagewin bi-bookondaan.
about.step_4_body: Asaan onjibaa-mazina'igan (e.g. "Global:") gemaa aabaji'an AI wiidookaazowin waabishkizi-wiindamaagewin.
about.feature_ai_body: Nanaandawi'an aaniin ozhibii'igewin wiindamaagewin aabadak mazina'igan tibibiiganan. Giin API ozhibii'igewin, giin AI {provider} — gaawiin wiikaa mashkimod-azhegiiwesii.
about.feature_a11y_body: WCAG 2.2: focus, live regions, keyboard, reduced motion, high-contrast.
about.coming_auth: Google aaniin GitHub sign in devices.
about.coming_custom: Biindigan mii dash aazhogiizhigan giinwenzh ozhibii'igewinan, biindaakojigewin gaa-dazhiikigaadeg ginwaabimowin.
settings.confirm_reset_all_body: API keys dóó settings mii dash. Giin gaawiin.
settings.unsaved_body: Giin AI ozhi'igaazowinan gaawiin asaajigaazod. Aaniin wii-izhichigeyin?

about.what_body_2: Gakina gegoo ji-naawakaa — mewizha, mii dash miinawaa. Ingii-wii-ganawenimaa gaa-pi-izhi-wiindamaagoziyaan ji-naawakaamagak gaa-izhiwebiziwin, gaa-mamaajisidood, gaa-wiindamaagewin, miinawaa gaa-izhichigewin ji-aabajichigaazod ji-giiziibiigidoonameg. Ziigwebii'an o'ow mashkimoding WCAG-izhi-ozhibii'igaadegin, baabaapi'an gaa-wiindamawid, agaasiidomaa gemaa biminizha'an, mii dash giga-ozhibii'aan chi-mashkimoding audit ozhibii'iganeng.
error.announce: Aaniin ezhiwebak — gaa-pi-izhiwebizid mashkimoding accessibility gaawiin ojiitaasiin. Babaamenimaan gidayaawing miinawaa gazhi-maajiidoon.
